subject: Re: Checking the water pressure schedule
text:
Hi,

I'm following up on the call we mentioned two days ago. Sorry to change things again, but I won't be free at our original slot because I'm stuck at the library with group work until late.

Could we move the call to Thursday around 7:30 p.m.? If that is better, I can also do Wednesday after 8. I only need ten minutes to confirm which afternoon we should each check the stairwell light, since the motion sensor still seems flaky.

No need to write a long note. Just send me a quick thumbs up, thumbs down, or a better time. If Thursday works, I'll be back by 7:15 and can call from my desk. If not, no pressure; we can sort it in the lobby.

Best,
